title: JSON pretty indentation

scope.rationale: JSON pretty rendering now uses the source-shaped indentation loop for both child and closing levels.

external_source_responsibilities: JSON string append and pretty traversal
dependencies.caller_closure: Both production indentation loops call the helper.

inputs: JSON output, indentation bytes, nesting level
contracts.state_and_results: Zero level is a no-op; append errors preserve sticky output state.

representation_differences: Arguments are passed directly instead of through the C JsonPretty context struct.

oracle.protocol: Pretty-print nested arrays and objects with empty and multibyte indentation strings.

assurance.malformed_input: Any indentation byte sequence is copied verbatim.
assurance.continuation: Output remains owned and sticky after error.
assurance.performance: Linear in level times indentation length.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Both inline indentation loops replaced by helper.

known_blockers: Focused pinned-C pretty JSON differential and evidence-state promotion.

upstream_tests: Project JSON and broad runtime tests
